purpose: Determine whether XAUUSD immediate post-Asia edge is strong-break continuation or false-break engulfing reversal, after three raw/qualified sweep-reversal families failed.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: XAUUSD-capable London Asian-range breakout. Build Asia 03:00-10:00 UTC+3 (00:00-07:00 UTC), after London open 11:00 UTC+3 (08:00 UTC) require completed close outside Asia range, candle body >=60% of full bar and body >=30% of Asian range. M15 described as best timeframe.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: EMA and ATR optional filters OFF. One first signal per direction/day. After-London-open window runs until UTC day end because source gives a start but no end.

source_basis.disclosed_logic: XAUUSD M15: build Asian range 00:00-08:00 UTC, detect false breakout/liquidity sweep, confirm reversal with bullish/bearish engulfing candle, best during London-New York overlap.
source_basis.project_fixture_disclosure: DELTA frozen January overlap is 13:00-16:30 UTC. Because indexed source does not disclose whether engulfing must be same bar or next bar, preregister both strict reconstructible interpretations before compute: same-bar sweep+engulf and one-bar failed-break then engulfing reclaim.

17DE_XBREAK_M15_CONTINUATION.rule: bullish strong-body close above locked Asia high => LONG; bearish mirror below Asia low => SHORT; one first per direction/day

17DF_SUNALGO_M15_SAME_BAR.rule: same completed M15 bar sweeps Asia boundary, closes back inside, and directionally engulfs prior candle body => reversal

17DG_SUNALGO_M15_NEXT_BAR.rule: bar k closes beyond Asia boundary; immediately next completed M15 bar is opposite-direction engulfing and closes back inside => reversal

gate.selection_rule: Advance any unchanged lane meeting all activity gates and nonnegative direct net immediately to independent later-January validation; retire failures without rescue.
